# OpenPGP.js

`openpgp.min.js` is `dist/openpgp.min.js` of the npm package `openpgp` 6.1.1, the version of
the browser extension, unmodified. It is licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License
3.0 or later (`LICENSE`); the `openpgpjs` feature of the SDK embeds it.

| File             | SHA-256                                                            |
|------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `openpgp.min.js` | `e7a4e4b2e0cfd864aa50b2cb0a7bb50052cc41b0b9a845843de9a6f2dbec386a` |

To check it against the registry:

```sh
npm pack openpgp@6.1.1 && tar xzf openpgp-6.1.1.tgz
sha256sum package/dist/openpgp.min.js
```
